senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; קָצָה) [one who decides, arbitrates,] magistrate, leader, prominent man.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 1:5:2">Y. Gitt. I, 43ᵈ</cite> top <he>הגע … של ק׳ וכ׳</he> suppose he was the bondman of an influential man, then his emancipation would be a disadvantage to him.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 2:3">Lam. R. to II, 1</cite> <he>בשביל … של ק׳ וכ׳</he> since thou livest in that leader’s house, why dost thou not correct them (the inmates)?
